nameJa: 斜めの赤とアイボリー
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 赤とアイボリーの対角線、大きな黒い機能名、重ねたカードの奥行きで、全画面内の会話を大胆に示す。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE stylish landscape Chrome extension listing image, exact 11:7 aspect ratio, target 1760 x 1120. It is an abstract typographic campaign with layered geometric video and chat symbols, no scene or photo.

Direction: dynamic, sophisticated red-and-ivory editorial layout. A bold diagonal division crosses the backdrop: rich YouTube red upper-left and warm ivory lower-right. Extremely crisp oversized black-and-white neo-grotesk type, clean proportions, sophisticated print-poster art direction. Layer a single slightly offset ivory widescreen video card over one thin black geometric shadow, subtle paper/material depth, not excessive 3D. Use sharp geometry, generous negative space and purposeful alignment. Nothing glowing or futuristic.

The video graphic is a clear 16:9 rectangle in the lower half. A black play triangle sits toward its left. One clean red chat panel OVERLAYS the RIGHT side INSIDE the COMPLETE video screen, entirely within its outer perimeter and inset at least 8 percent from its edges. ONLY three ivory horizontal strokes in that chat plus tiny circles; no readable chat content. Four bold fullscreen corner marks indicate the COMPLETE outer video boundary including the overlaid chat. Thus the chat is visibly inside the fullscreen video, not an adjacent separate app.

The three and only text elements appear exactly once each:
"YouTube"
"Fullscreen"
"Live Chat"
Put YouTube in readable medium type near the upper-left; give the two functional words a strong editorial arrangement across the upper area using large confident black or ivory lettering. Exact spelling, one word Fullscreen. Every character completely visible with 7 percent safe margins. Keep diagram and letters separate, absolutely no text in the chat graphic.
No slogans, additional labels, fake UI text, numbers, watermark, branded official badge, people, game, landscape, photographs, UI dashboard, icons collection or collage. Finished edge-to-edge marketing artwork.
